_comment: Optional. Copy to build/config.json and re-run ./install.sh --force.
Every value defaults to empty and every consumer guards for that, so
skipping this file entirely is fine -- those features just stay off.
Find a library id by opening the library in Jellyfin and reading
topParentId (or parentId) out of the address bar.
_services: These point at self-hosted companion apps. Leave blank unless you run
them -- a blank value removes the feature rather than leaving a dead link.
The request/search bridge is found automatically at /requestbridge on the
same origin (or port 8099 on a direct LAN connection), so it needs no key.
